standard_prerequisites.name: Coherent sheaves form a Serre subcategory of quasi-coherent sheaves on a Noetherian scheme
standard_prerequisites.use: One of the two conditions of the derived category embedding lemma.

standard_prerequisites.name: Every quasi-coherent module surjecting onto a coherent module has a coherent submodule still surjecting onto it, via the filtered union of coherent submodules
standard_prerequisites.use: The second condition of the derived category embedding lemma (resolution property of the inclusion).

standard_prerequisites.name: The derived category criterion for a Serre subcategory inclusion to induce a fully faithful and essentially surjective embedding on bounded above derived categories

core_obligations: Observe Coh(O_X) is a Serre subcategory of QCoh(O_X) on a Noetherian scheme, citing the homology definitions and the two coherent lemmas (proof lines 2793-2799).

Show the surjection lifting property: given a surjection G -> F with F coherent and G quasi-coherent, write G as the filtered union of its coherent submodules by the properties lemma; one of them surjects onto F (proof lines 2800-2807).
Conclude the equivalence from the derived category fully-faithful-embedding lemma, whose two conditions are now verified (proof lines 2808-2809).
proof_roadmap: Verify the Serre subcategory condition (proof lines 2793-2799).
Verify the coherent-resolution condition via the filtered union argument (proof lines 2800-2807).
Apply the derived category embedding criterion (proof lines 2808-2809).
